children: announced two aviation milestones Tuesday, including the first flight of an uncrewed aircraft in commercial airspace using vertiports for both takeoff and landing and the production of the 500th Cessna Citation Latitude business jet.
Textron Systems said its Aerosonde unmanned aircraft flew nearly 150 nautical miles through commercial airspace in Virginia as part of the state's Advanced Air Mobility Smart Airspace Program.

The Aerosonde Mk. 4.7 vertical takeoff and landing aircraft departed from a vertiport at the Virginia Tech Transportation Institute in Blacksburg and landed about two and a half hours later at another vertiport at Textron Systems' Aerosonde Center of Excellence in Blackstone.
Textron Systems conducted the demonstration with the Mid-Atlantic Aviation Partnership at Virginia Tech, one of seven Federal Aviation Administration-designated UAS test sites.
The Virginia program, launched in March 2025, is studying how advanced air mobility aircraft and supporting infrastructure such as vertiports can operate within the existing aviation system.

The Aerosonde is designed for land and maritime operations and has accumulated more than 750,000 flight hours. The aircraft can carry more than 40 payload configurations for missions including intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance and electronic warfare.
Separately, Textron Aviation rolled out the 500th Cessna Citation Latitude from its manufacturing facility in Wichita, Kansas.

The midsize business jet has a four-passenger range of 2,700 nautical miles and can carry as many as nine passengers. It has a maximum cruise speed of 446 knots and a takeoff field length of 3,580 feet (1.09 kilometers).

The Latitude entered service in 2015 and has become one of Textron Aviation's major Citation business jet models. The 500th rollout marks a production milestone more than a decade after the aircraft joined the Citation lineup.
Textron Aviation and Textron Systems are both subsidiaries of Providence, Rhode Island-based Textron.

title: Textron marks Aerosonde UAS flight, 500th Citation Latitude rollout
